summary: Full source/quiz review and local schema/Avro validation completed.
findings: Corrected Karapace Protobuf support, component license scope, registry migration and serializer/wire-format caveats.
Fixed Avro logicalType nesting; validated reader defaults, conditional forward compatibility on removal, numeric promotion and non-transitive history.
Replaced plaintext old-cluster deployment with Apicurio 3.3.3/Strimzi v1 precreated topics, scoped ACLs, TLS/SCRAM, explicit hostname verification and current health management port.
Verified KafkaSQL journal/snapshots/events initialization, default no-compaction/no-retention checks, random group replay and separate snapshot-file persistence.
Registered the same canonical schema under orders-value using ccompat/v7 and explicit BACKWARD_TRANSITIVE; separated producer serializer from consumer deserializer settings.
Updated all 36 quiz questions and preserved chapter navigation; no images in these files.
